end.summary: Defined food miles as the distance food travels to reach us.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised linking longer journeys with more fuel use and identified that local food usually travels less and may be fresher. They also discussed limits such as refrigeration, electricity, packaging, and waste. The initial mix-up about food miles adding nutrients was corrected later when they explained the distance-based meaning accurately. At home, ask Rohan to compare two foods and list their likely travel distance, fuel, cooling, and packaging needs.
